review.midjourney.how.does.midjourney.v6: How does Midjourney V6 compare to DALL-E 3?
review.midjourney.midjourney.v6.produces: Midjourney V6 produces more consistently artistic, visually stunning images. DALL-E 3 is better at understanding complex natural language prompts and has better text rendering. DALL-E 3 is easier to use (integrated into ChatGPT), while Midjourney requires learning Discord commands. Quality-wise, they're comparable, with Midjourney having a slight edge on pure aesthetics.

review.midjourney.fast.mode.uses.dedicat: Fast Mode uses dedicated GPU resources and generates images in ~60 seconds. It consumes your monthly GPU hours (3.3 hrs on Basic, 15 hrs on Standard, etc.). Relax Mode is unlimited but queued—images take 5-10 minutes depending on server load. Relax is only available on Standard, Pro, and Mega plans.

review.stable-diffusion.how.does.sdxl.co: How does SDXL compare to Midjourney quality?
review.stable-diffusion.sdxl.can.match.m: SDXL can match Midjourney V6 quality with proper checkpoints (like Realistic Vision) and LoRAs. Out-of-the-box, Midjourney is more consistent. Stable Diffusion requires tuning but offers more control once mastered.
review.stable-diffusion.is.stable.diffus: Is Stable Diffusion safe and legal?
review.stable-diffusion.yes.the.software: Yes, the software is legal and safe. It has no content filters, so users must follow local laws. The open-source code is auditable for security.
review.stable-diffusion.what.are.loras.a: What are LoRAs and why do they matter?
review.stable-diffusion.loras.low-rank.a: LoRAs (Low-Rank Adaptation) are small models that add specific styles, characters, or concepts to SDXL. They're trained by the community and shared on Civitai. They allow infinite customization impossible with cloud-only tools.
review.stable-diffusion.can.i.run.stable: Can I run Stable Diffusion without a GPU?
Technically yes (CPU-only), but generation takes 10-30 minutes per image vs 10-30 seconds with a GPU. Rent cloud GPUs (RunPod, VastAI) for ~$0.20-0.50/hour if you don't own one.
